question: Does a weekly-seasonal forecast beat a same-weekday seasonal-naive baseline for daily orders?
action: adopt the weekly-seasonal forecast only where it clears the no-skill null; keep the seasonal-naive baseline otherwise

evidence.baseline: same-weekday seasonal naive (lag 7), recursive over the test block
evidence.falsifier: the mean fold-improvement interval falls at or below max(min_effect, the paired sign-flip null at this n) — the model would be indistinguishable from the seasonal-naive baseline

provenance.exclusions: 2016-09 is the launch month (4 orders on its first day) and 2016-11 has no orders, so the series starts at 2017-01-01 to estimate a weekly cycle on complete months. The 2018-09/10 tail is partial (16 and 4 orders), so 2018-08-31 is the final complete day and the tail is excluded.
